structured.answer: I'd open a Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) account and put 750 ₪ a month into the Yalin Lapidot S&P 500 tracker fund (ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)), the pair the page marks as cheapest. The page says I'd have about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after 15 years, assuming 7% a year return and 2% a year inflation.

stuck.why: Slider showed 800 while the box said 750; I wasn't sure which one the page used

The inflation assumption (2%) is hidden behind a button; the main number only says 'בכסף של היום'
Unclear whether the 7% return already has inflation taken off
Dollar rate and European central bank note sit on the inflation line and confuse it
